title: A $(2,6)$-hypercontractive inequality for the noise operator
statement:
Let $\rho\in\bbr$ satisfy $\rho^2\le \tfrac15$, and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be any Boolean function. Then the sixth moment of the noised function $T_\rho f$ is controlled by the cube of the second moment of $f$:
\[
  \E\bigl[(T_\rho f)^6\bigr] \;\le\; \bigl(\E[f^2]\bigr)^3,
\]
where both expectations are taken with respect to the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
For $\rho^2 \le 1/5$ and any Boolean function $f$,
\[
  \E[(T_\rho f)^6] \le \bigl(\E[f^2]\bigr)^3.
\]
